boundary_policy.interpretation: The intrinsic candidate has no Casimir modifier. A boundary-dependent extension is a different model and must pass the existing manifold-kernel registry before it can supply any prediction.

outcome_map.disfavors: An intrinsic contraction at the achieved sensitivity.

nonbridges.statement: Rest-mass or Compton frequency is not connected to a cavity mode or collapse clock without a sourced transfer kernel.
Scalar Casimir pressure or reference-subtracted energy cannot replace the complete branch stress tensor or Penrose incompatibility functional.
Negative reference-subtracted field energy is not negative apparatus mass or curvature proof.
Virtual-particle language supplies no prepared branch object, hazard law, or collapse clock.
The existence of classical gravitational waves does not derive quantum-geometry interference or objective reduction.
Superconductivity, Anderson-Higgs physics, the Standard Model Higgs field, and BEC relations are calibration or platform physics, not collapse generators.
NHM2 force, amplification, and car-weight proxy values are not imported as gravitational mass or a Penrose source.
A retarded mean metric response produces ordinary signed phase, not nonunitary reduction by itself.
Noise-induced open-system decoherence does not establish ontic single outcomes without a physical stochastic unravelling.
